name: Grade 7 Integrated Science: The Human Skeleton
subject: Integrated Science
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to name the main parts of the human skeleton
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to state the functions of the skeleton
learningActivities: Discussion: learners feel the bones in their arms and legs
Chart work: teacher uses a skeleton chart to name the main bones
Group work: learners label a skeleton diagram
Summary: learners state the functions of the skeleton
keyPoints: The skeleton is the framework of bones in the body
Main bones include the skull, ribs, backbone and limb bones
The skeleton supports the body, protects organs and enables movement
commonMisconceptions: Thinking the skull is one solid bone
lessonEvaluation: Learners label a skeleton diagram and state three functions of the skeleton.
teacherReflection: Learners were fascinated by the skeleton chart. Follow-up: joints and muscles.
